exposure: Neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 negative mothers
Neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 positive mothers
cohort: 81 neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 positive mothers and 162 matched neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 negative mothers
finding: While neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 positive mothers had a higher rate of gastrointestinal symptoms, neonatal outcomes were generally comparable to those born to SARS-CoV-2 negative mothers, with limited neonatal positivity and no evidence of vertical transmission.
mod_finding: SARS-CoV-2 positive women were more likely to undergo Cesarean section.
